notes:
Sales notes and call snippets:
- Very large legacy media archive (video transcripts + OCR'd scripts + editorial notes). Customer estimate: ~12M documents (files) / ~1.3B tokens raw; average file length 6k-15k tokens.
- Primary objective: replace old keyword search with semantic RAG search + reranking to surface best splice/snippet for editorial retrieval.
- Quote from Head of Search: "Need results to be precise — show exact snippet and confidence; latency matters for editor UX."
- Interested in hybrid deployment: dedicated pool in their cloud (VPC) with sensitive subset in on-prem for legal/regulatory items.
- Churn risk noted if first POC shows 400ms+ median latency. Customer target: median end-to-end (retrieve+rerank) <150ms for short queries, 95pct <400ms under 200 qps.
- Cost sensitivity: target ~<$0.02 per query at 100 qps steady-state. Will trade some latency for cost but prefers clear unit economics.
- Security checklist: require SSO (SAML), audit logs pushed to their SIEM, KMS integration, quarterly pen-test report. Data residency required for EU-sourced content.
- Current stack: Elasticsearch for metadata, S3 object store, internal annotation tool. Considering Redwood to replace vector infra + reranker layer.
- Prototype index approach discussed: on-the-fly chunking for ingestion, HNSW ANN for candidate retrieval, cross-encoder reranker for top-10 re-score.
- Open question from call: how to store large KV cache across many long-context queries; suggested using prefix caching + smart chunk prioritization.
- Asked for concrete cost model: storage for 12M docs (after chunking ~48M chunks) + query cost estimation for 200 qps. Provided preliminary calc in drive deck.
- Legal: need contract clause for on-prem air-gap (some EU customers).
- SE feedback: want ability to A/B reranker thresholds and experiment with overlap sizes (512 vs 1,024 tokens).
- They attached sample transcript set (20k docs) for evaluation; want Redwood to run relevance metrics vs baseline BM25 and existing embeddings pipeline.

use_case_summary: Archivex needs a RAG-based search for long-form media artifacts (video transcripts, OCR'd scripts, editorial notes). Workload: high cardinality long documents; need embeddings for semantic retrieval + a cross-encoder reranker to improve precision for editorial workflows. Key metrics: indexing scale (~48M chunks after chunking), median query latency <150ms, cost per query target <$0.02 at 100-200 qps, high relevance (nDCG uplift vs BM25).
indexing_requirements: Scale: ingest 12M source files -> estimated 3.5x chunk expansion -> ~48M vectors. Chunking strategy under consideration: 800-1,200 token chunks with 128 token overlap for continuity; alternate experiments with 512 token chunks for finer granularity. Need streaming ingestion with incremental reindexing (nightly refresh) and ability to pin high-priority collections. Storage: compressed quantized vectors (8-bit/4-bit) to reduce footprint; plan for sharded HNSW with warm-up policies.
performance_requirements: Latency targets: median retrieve (ANN) + rerank (top-10 cross-encoder) <150ms for typical short queries; 95th pct <400ms at sustained 200 qps. Throughput: baseline 100 qps, burst to 250 qps. Cold-start concerns: index warming strategy needed to avoid 2-3s tails after daily reindex. SLO discussion needed around fallback to lower-cost approximate reranker when under load.
reranker_strategy: Candidate selection: HNSW (faiss/ann) for top-K (K=100) retrieval. Reranker: cross-encoder fine-tuned on internal relevance labels (initial seed: distil cross-encoder checkpoint). Evaluation plan: measure MRR/nDCG against editorial relevance labels. Tuning experiments: chunk overlap effect, top-K size tradeoffs (50 vs 200), per-customer reranker threshold for precision/recall, temperature and truncation policies for generation of snippet context. Discussed using smaller distilled reranker in Dedicated for latency and fallback to larger model for nightly re-ranks.
poc_plan: Phase 1 (2 weeks): Ingest 250k sample docs provided by Archivex; build vector index; baseline metrics vs BM25 and existing embeddings
Phase 2 (2 weeks): Run reranker A/B tests (cross-encoder vs lightweight re-ranker); measure latency/cost per query under 50/100 qps
Phase 3 (4 weeks): Scale test up to 3M chunks in dedicated environment; tune chunking overlap and quantization; finalize SLA and pricing
Deliverables: relevance report (nDCG/MRR), latency profiles, cost model, recommended chunking and reranker config
